notes:
Downloads now pick up where they left off.

Kokoro is a 305 MB download, and until now a connection that dropped at 90% threw all of it away and started again. It now asks only for the part it is missing — so a lost signal, a walk out of Wi-Fi range, or closing the app costs you the last few seconds instead of the whole thing.

Also fixed: the chapter heading printed into the artwork is no longer read out. On some titles it sits on a pale panel, and the app mistook that for a speech bubble — so a character would announce "Chapter 104: descendant of the future" before the story started. It is treated as page furniture now, the same as page numbers and scanlation watermarks.
